name: api-architect
description: Contract, collection, emit-handler, audit, and publish skills for designing, implementing, documenting, and governing REST APIs. Stack-neutral rules (real HTTP status codes, RFC 9457 problem+json errors, resource-oriented verbs, cursor pagination, bearer-token auth) grounded in current industry practice, with Oracle ORDS + PL/SQL as the primary worked implementation. api-collection generates a runnable Postman collection and the API reference from one manifest, so the two cannot disagree.
